title: CALIPER: Comparative Analysis of LLM Inference Perturbation, Evaluation, and Ranking
description:
CALIPER archival package accompanying EMSE Paper 1 (Model-Task Heterogeneity and Instrumentation Distortion in HumanEval+ Pass@1 Evaluation). Authors: César Andrés (corresponding; ORCID 0009-0001-8968-3404); David Martín-Moncunill (ORCID 0000-0003-2422-9005); José Manuel Baños (ORCID 0009-0004-9971-7390).

CONFIRMATORY ARTIFACT (immutable freeze content): artifacts/paper1/frozen/statistical_dataset.parquet (N=39,360; SHA-256 95209fff2f742d59b52aa5cf5616f1395ef7fc01fd87fe025c485577bca0d1c9) plus freeze/integrity/recovery docs. This is the locked HumanEval+ analysis dataset for primary confirmatory inference. Do not regenerate to audit confirmatory tables.

POST-FREEZE DIAGNOSTIC EVIDENCE (not confirmatory N): artifacts/paper1/qwen3_postfreeze_diagnostics/ — Arm A (think-off, N=6560), Arm B (sequential think-on, final stored n=801), and freeze-era Qwen3 forensic cell extract for Appendix A. See that directory README.md and SHA256SUMS.

Historical software-only GitHub/Zenodo snapshot under concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21780088 remains available as version v1.0.0. This v1.1.0 deposit adds/clarifies confirmatory freeze + post-freeze diagnostics for EMSE auditability.

Entry points: README.md, artifacts/paper1/README.md, artifacts/paper1/qwen3_postfreeze_diagnostics/README.md. Development: https://github.com/cesar-andress/caliper.
